text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden, and I’d love to help create a clean, simple logo for Warden AI.

I have 6 years of experience working with Python, machine learning, NLP, and AI tools, and while my background is technical rather than design-focused, I understand how important it is for an AI startup to have a logo that feels modern, minimal, and trustworthy. I’m comfortable working fast, collaborating over a brief call, and making quick edits based on feedback.

Your one-week turnaround and direct communication style suit me well. I can help keep the process simple and responsive so you get a logo that matches your brand name and typography.

I’d be glad to discuss your vision and get started right away.
